options.say: Ten cents the page. Fifteen if it’s going well.
options.repeat: Ten cents the page. Fifteen if it’s going well.

options.say: If a man’s had a good week I write more. If he’s had a bad week I write much more. Bad weeks are my living.

options.text: Do you ever write the truth?
options.say: Once. Fella insisted. I charged him double and he cried the whole time.
options.repeat: Once. And I charged him double.

options.say: I know. I’ve read them over your shoulder. You’re not bad. You’re just honest, which is a phase.

speakerNote: Who says the replies. Without it DialogueRunner leaves `sayer` null, the renderer cannot find a head to put the words over, and they fall to the top-centre fallback in the wrong colour -- which is exactly what Tyler saw.
gateNote: Doc 07’s ↳ notation: "going_well" is a FOLLOW-UP, offered only once "charge" has been asked. Without the gate every option is on the list from the first moment, which had the pie woman offering to argue with an answer nobody had given.
